speaker: Sera
quote: I keep sending people to the wall. I would like to stand there myself for once. But I cannot leave this table open.
text: I keep sending people to the wall. I would like to stand there myself for once. But I cannot leave this table open.

speaker: Sera
quote: Take the blank cards. Bring back the empty tray too. People should have somewhere to put a question when they find one.
text: Take the blank cards. Bring back the empty tray too. People should have somewhere to put a question when they find one.

speaker: Sera
quote: Stay on this side. If someone asks for a source, ask them to wait for me. You do not have to answer for anybody.

speaker: Sera
quote: You brought the tray back empty. That is all right. An empty place for a question is still worth keeping.

speaker: Sera
quote: I heard the voices from the wall instead of through this doorway. Thank you for staying.

quote: Leave a space beside the account. Someone may come back with a question after we have gone.
